species.nutrition: Microbe-associated food on fermenting organic matter
species.habitat: Fermenting fruit and other microbe-rich substrates; laboratory cultures
species.range: Widely distributed human-associated populations. Body source: adult female laboratory specimen; no field occurrence is inferred.
species.summary: An extensively studied dipteran linking molecular genetics, photoreceptor physiology, neural anatomy and behavior. Explore the local FlyBody exterior, the molecular benchmark and separately sourced connectome examples. They are different specimens and do not form a validated whole-animal simulation.

visual.description: Female FlyBody geometry with paler olive-tan cuticle, softer segment bands, reduced gloss and translucent wings. Photo-guided materials are not calibrated reflectance. The unchanged source-derived movement has a separate external audit with mismatches; no neural or aerodynamic simulation runs here.

behaviors.label: Walking · source trajectory
behaviors.description: A 0.61-second fitted FlyBody walking reference (trajectory 092), played 10× slower with the body held fixed. Six articulated legs retain the published coordination. This is one tracked/fitted example, not a universal gait or independent validation.
behaviors.studyNote: Display time is slowed for inspection. The source clock appears below; this reconstruction is not an independently validated measurement.

behaviors.label: Flight · wingbeat study
behaviors.description: Two cycles of the published wing-angle pattern, displayed 436× slower. The source generator uses 218 Hz; this is not a universal flight frequency. Legs use the source retracted posture. Haltere oscillation is a literature-guided schematic addition. Hover orientation is illustrative; lift, airflow and free-flight trajectory are not simulated.
behaviors.studyNote: Display time is slowed for inspection. The source clock appears below; this reconstruction is not an independently validated measurement.

motorEvidence.title: P9 / DNp09 · initiating forward walking
motorEvidence.evidence: Activation experiments support a role for this descending neuron pair in forward walking and ipsilateral turning. A separate BPN pathway evokes a different forward-walking program.
motorEvidence.limit: No P9 activity was recorded with this displayed trajectory. Activation evidence does not specify each leg joint angle.

motorEvidence.title: Femoral chordotonal organ · leg feedback
motorEvidence.evidence: Proprioceptor classes encode femur–tibia position, movement direction and vibration. Claw, hook and club populations carry different signals.
motorEvidence.limit: These are class-level experimental findings. No sensory feedback loop or proprioceptor firing is simulated in the replay.

motorEvidence.title: DNg02 population · wingbeat amplitude
motorEvidence.evidence: Perturbation and imaging experiments link a population of descending neurons to graded wingbeat-amplitude control and visual responses.
motorEvidence.limit: DNg02 does not provide one command per wingbeat in this display. The asynchronous flight motor and neural activity are not simulated.

motorEvidence.title: Halteres · rotation feedback
motorEvidence.evidence: Mechanical rotation experiments demonstrate haltere-mediated equilibrium reflexes alongside visual stabilization. Halteres beat in antiphase with the wings.
motorEvidence.limit: The added approximately 180° haltere sweep is schematic, not a simultaneous recording matched to these wing angles; source hinge orientation is retained.
